title: the BUILDME chart lane reads a validate berth charted on another box by its commons copy
intention: The BUILDME entry lane buildme_rides_the_chart finds a validate berth charted on another box by its commons copy, through chain.claiming_packets, so a ticket charted on one box crosses BUILDME on any.
why: Law 7 and the one-reader rule of e8fb6bcd23c5: 2026-11-19, akiendell_cc_0 re-crossing 2a530dc20826 and 3413bea597fc at BUILDME after both were charted on akiendelllinux (validate-20261119T211210-3a685918b151, validate-20261119T211220-a718e3e0fb77; 14 berths/chart copies in the commons): both refused with one finding each, `[buildme_rides_the_chart] chart chain claims this ticket (expected: True, actual: False, {"searched": "C:\\Users\\akien\\.cairn\\devices\\chart"})`. cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:2090-2095 globs its own _CHART_BERTHS root for validate-*.json and never reads through cairn/tools/chain/chain.py claiming_packet_paths, whose _packet_index (cairn/tools/chain/chain.py:229-234) adds the commons mirror where this box lacks the berth (e8fb6bcd23c5, PROVED). The third site of one shape: 1e99a571dd6d (sail.verdict, PROVED) and 7cae18f7f9c2 (codemother's verdict gate, at BUILDME) fixed the same far-box read at their own readers.
traces_to: RULE 1 (one reader, the chain tool's); Law 1 (the third site of one settled shape)
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py buildme_rides_the_chart: when berths_root is None, green iff claiming_packets(ticket, 'validate') (already imported from cairn.tools.chain.chain) returns any packet. It reads the local root and the commons mirror, and every ticket spelling. When berths_root is given, pass it through as berths_root= so a fixture's world stays the caller's. The red finding's searched lists the local root and the mirror (chain._mirror_for). cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_buildme_reads_a_far_box_chart_by_its_commons_copy.py: one tooth per clause, a scratch chart root plus a scratch commons mirror, in the shape of cairn/devices/codemother/machines/chart_gate/proofs/test_the_verdict_gate_reads_a_far_box_berth_by_its_commons_copy.py.

clauses.claim: with no validate berth under the local chart root and its commons copy under CairnCommons/berths/chart claiming the ticket, buildme_rides_the_chart returns no finding
with neither a local berth nor a commons copy claiming the ticket, it returns one finding, and its `searched` names both the local root and the commons mirror
a local validate berth claiming the ticket still returns no finding, and a berths_root a caller passes is still the one read

decisions.text: D1: buildme_rides_the_chart reads through chain.claiming_packets, mirror included.
D2: red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_buildme_reads_a_far_box_chart_by_its_commons_copy.py, one tooth per clause.

The third site of one shape: 1e99a571dd6d (sail.verdict, PROVED) and 7cae18f7f9c2 (codemother's verdict gate, at BUILDME) fixed the same far-box read at their own readers
measured.how: akiendell_cc_0's BUILDME refusal lines; read cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py:2084-2108 and cairn/tools/chain/chain.py:213-265
